Time processing on the selected runtime

```text
dspk benchmark [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## `dspk benchmark pipeline`

A PipelineWorkspace (scale → notch → TKEO): upload, stages, download

```text
dspk benchmark pipeline [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`-c, --channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `384`  
  Channels
- **`-s, --samples <SAMPLES>`**: default `30000`  
  Samples per channel
- **`-r, --sample-rate <SAMPLE_RATE>`**: default `30000`  
  Sample rate (Hz): sets the filters and the real-time factor
- **`-i, --iterations <ITERATIONS>`**: default `5`  
  Timed repetitions (the median is reported)
- **`--int16`**  
  Upload int16 stored samples (scaled on the device) instead of f32
- **`--save <SAVE>`**  
  Write the output once as raw binary + sidecar (timed separately)

## `dspk benchmark sweep`

The pipeline's stages across channel counts

```text
dspk benchmark sweep [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`-c, --channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `384`  
  Channels
- **`-s, --samples <SAMPLES>`**: default `30000`  
  Samples per channel
- **`-r, --sample-rate <SAMPLE_RATE>`**: default `30000`  
  Sample rate (Hz): sets the filters and the real-time factor
- **`-i, --iterations <ITERATIONS>`**: default `5`  
  Timed repetitions (the median is reported)

## `dspk benchmark suite`

Every kernel family and streaming detection; writes a JSON report

```text
dspk benchmark suite [OPTIONS] --report-dir <REPORT_DIR>
```

**Options**

- **`-c, --channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `384`  
  Channels
- **`-s, --samples <SAMPLES>`**: default `30000`  
  Samples per channel
- **`-r, --sample-rate <SAMPLE_RATE>`**: default `30000`  
  Sample rate (Hz): sets the filters and the real-time factor
- **`-i, --iterations <ITERATIONS>`**: default `5`  
  Timed repetitions (the median is reported)
- **`--report-dir <REPORT_DIR>`**  
  Folder for the report (`<unix time>-<runtime>.json`)
